          Fig. 02 — Closure sites by state, top ten

            Bubble area is proportional to the number of federal closure sites in the state. Counts, not rates: they track where for-profit and cosmetology schools clustered.

            Fig. 03 — Closure sites over time

            Each mark is a Title IV closure site placed by the Census Bureau geocoder. Dark squares are main campuses, pale squares branches and annexes, blue marks closed in the selected year, rings the curated campuses. Alaska, Hawaii, and Puerto Rico sit in insets.
